theorems.name: Submission.p03_odd_division_detection_68cf3476
theorems.statement: ∀ (F : Type) [Field F] [CharZero F] [DecidableEq F] (W : WeierstrassCurve F), W.Δ ≠ 0 → ∀ (n : ℕ), 3 ≤ n → Odd n → (W.preΨ' n).natDegree = (n ^ 2 - 1) / 2 ∧ (W.preΨ' n).leadingCoeff = (n : F) ∧ ∀ (x y : F) (h : W.toAffine.Nonsingular x y), n • WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Point.some x y h = 0 ↔ (W.preΨ' n).eval x = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Combines the accepted degree-and-leading-coefficient theorem with the accepted odd predivision-polynomial torsion criterion.
